invalid_link: This link isn't right or was already used. Make a new one on a signed-in device
title: Connect to Persona
get_link: How do I get a sign-in link?
phone_step_open: On a signed-in device, open Settings and find {path}. On Apple and the web, look under Advanced. Choose Browser.
phone_step_copy: Choose Copy sign-in link. Open the link in this browser or paste it into the field.
phone_step_scan: On a phone or tablet, you can also open the link by scanning the code on the signed-in device with your camera.
link_placeholder: Paste a sign-in or pairing link
credential_note: This browser gets its own credentials. You can revoke them anytime in Settings › Advanced › Devices.
no_hub_what: The hub is the Persona service on an always-on computer (a home computer, NAS or server). Your phone and the web both connect to it. This page is served by a hub.
no_hub_yours: If you set it up: it showed a QR code when it was installed. Scan that with Persona on your phone first, then follow the steps above for this browser.
no_hub_others: If someone else set it up: ask them to make a sign-in link for you on a signed-in device.
advanced: Advanced: sign in with the hub's master key
master_warning: This is the hub's master key. Whoever has it can do anything, so don't share it. This browser trades it for its own credentials and doesn't keep it.
master_where: On the hub machine, run {pair} or {jq}.
password_pairing: Scan or use a pairing link
qr_expired: Code expired. Refresh to try again.
qr_failed: Could not load the sign-in code. Try again.
qr_scanned: Scanned. Allow it on your phone.
qr_hint: In Persona settings on your phone, find Devices and choose Scan browser sign-in code. Scan and approve this code within 5 minutes.
qr_retry: Reconnecting… Your sign-in request is kept.
qr_open: Scan a code with Persona on your phone
qr_title: Scan this code with Persona on your phone
qr_number_hint: Type the number your phone shows. One try: a wrong number cancels this sign-in.
qr_voided: That number didn't match, so this sign-in was cancelled. Refresh the code to try again.
